verifications.claim: Electronic filing of federal income taxes must be submitted by 11:59 p.m. local time on April 15, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'transmitted on or before midnight on Tax Day'; R3: 'e-file your tax forms by midnight on Tax Day' and 'don't wait until 11:59 p.m.'; R4: 'submitted online before midnight in your time zone'; R6: 'Electronic returns must be submitted by 11:59 p.m. local time on the deadline' (April 15, 2026).
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly confirm electronic filing deadline as midnight (11:59 p.m.) local time on April 15, 2026.

verifications.claim: Paper returns for federal income taxes must be postmarked by April 15, 2026.

verifications.evidence: R1: 'postmarked by the due date' (April 15, 2026); R3: 'postmarked by April 15'; R4: 'April 15, 2026, postmark'; R6: 'Paper returns must be properly addressed, postmarked'.
verifications.reasoning: All sources explicitly state paper returns are timely if postmarked by April 15, 2026.
